notes_for_editor: Height and survey date are from the 1956 NGS description (station PID EJ1998). The 1929 build year comes only from argenweb.net, a hobbyist compilation; no Forest Service record found. The 'only three remain standing' statement is made for the Mena and Oden districts; the page does not expressly place Pigeon Roost in those districts, though it covers Montgomery County. Brief had no height, so 17.7 m is added as a fact, not a correction. Search results mention a different Pigeon Roost tower in Grant County, West Virginia; not used. A Glenwood location link was unverified and is left out.
